caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, across various categories, comparing the performance of different models or configurations. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition," while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. Similarly, for PolitiFact, the dark red bar "Ours" has a value of 90.57, the orange bar "w/o comments" has a value of 85.85, the yellow bar "w/o text" has a value of 83.02, the light blue bar "w/o select" has a value of 89.62, the blue bar "w/o emotion" has a value of 84.91, and the dark blue bar "w/o cognition" has a value of 87.74. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing the same categories, and are colored according to their respective labels.
